properties.name: Level-Based MathE MCQ Selection
properties.description: Selects MathE multiple-choice questions for a topic and numeric proficiency level and returns the question items as JSON text without answer explanations.

properties.name: Test Recommendation
properties.description: Selects MathE multiple-choice questions (statement, answer options, index of the correct option), returned as JSON text, suited to a student's proficiency level on a MathE topic. Returns the questions only, without any explanation of the answers.
